artifacts_produced.deploy_evidence: Reads the plan, 5,252 bronze objects and 563 served gold partitions (S3 GET/LIST only), links the served daily returns over each segment, grades against 0.35 pp, assigns a reason only on named evidence, writes the record. 0 vendor calls.
7 offline pytest tests on synthetic inputs: within tolerance, outside with reason (COVERAGE_DAYS, UNEXPLAINED, MISSING_PRICE), not_gradable with a why, counts reconcile, BD point reader.

Per-segment record: 9,082 planned = 9,078 graded + 4 not gradable; 2,103 within, 6,975 outside (FLOW_TIMING 150, MISSING_PRICE 2, INCOME_DATE 568, COVERAGE_DAYS 5, UNEXPLAINED 6,250). Carries client figures; stays in the deliverables folder.

mutant.description: The synthetic tests are each other's negative arms: an in-tolerance segment must not carry a reason, an OUTSIDE segment with no evidence must be UNEXPLAINED, a missing account / missing BD value / missing BD response must be NOT_GRADABLE with a why.
mutant.expected: WITHIN carries no reason; OUTSIDE carries a closed-set reason and evidence; NOT_GRADABLE carries a why; counts reconcile

determinism.method: The re-linked served return was compared with the plan's own opal_twr on every segment.
